decision: Keep the Streamer interface unchanged and use simple internal output controls

adapter_contract.vad_start: Send pause when assistant output is active and open one 500 millisecond candidate
adapter_contract.turn_change: Send flush, rotate context once, interrupt old TTS, LLM and EOS work, then replay held text

streamer_contract.delivery: Internal stream values use the existing Notify and Send path
streamer_contract.pause: Retain queued local audio and stop consuming it
streamer_contract.flush: Discard retained local audio and invoke any existing provider clear
streamer_contract.identifiers: No pause ID, response ID or output epoch is added

rollout_constraint: Do not enable or release the adapter path until every configured streamer consumes all three controls
